columns.arrays: same-step outcomes: forbidden as forecasting features (lags only)
columns.data_quality_flags: never a model feature; use for masking/evaluation only (is_night/solar_elev_deg are deterministic and may be recomputed as features)
columns.features_weather: observed, not forecast: lag by >= horizon, or use declared weather scenarios

known_at_origin: plant and array history up to the origin
observed weather up to the origin
not_known_at_origin: any weather value inside the forecast window (the dataset has no weather forecasts)
forecast_protocol_ASSUMPTION.note: Default protocol proposed during preprocessing; change it deliberately before feature engineering.
